::: {.minipage data-latex="{\textwidth}"}
### `SetLanguage` {#standard-setprojectlanguage}

Changes the language for the project.
This will affect syllable counting and also which tests are available.

#### Syntax {-}

``` {.lua}
SetLanguage(Language lang)
```

#### Parameters {-}

**Parameter** | **Description**
| :-- | :-- |
| [`Language`](#language) lang | The language to set the project to. |

:::: {.tipsection data-latex=""}
This can be optimized by placing it in between calls to [`DelayReloading()`](#standard-delayreloading) and [`Reload()`](#standard-reload).
::::
:::
